_comment: Rig-parameterized corpus config. Spec v0.3 Section 3 targets 3 printers x 2 stocks; the current rig is 1-2 printers and multiple phones, so printers/stocks list only what is on hand. Extend these lists as the rig grows; intake.py validates against them. Printer and stock are recorded at capture time, NOT baked into the document PNG.
